integrity: Analytic proof plus exact-rational matrix verification; no external certification, no infinite computational enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Requires finite connected vertex- and edge-transitive core, symmetric stochastic uniform-stationary transitions and zero-diagonal Kemeny normalization; no nonsymmetric or nonuniform-stationary classification. The weighted-corona resistance identity and generic convexity framework are prior results. Publication priority subject to independent full-source review.
title: Sharp Kemeny regret and optimal stochastic walks on transitive leaf coronas
